slides.title: Can't start cleaning? Put on three songs. That's the whole plan.
Song 1: trash
slides.body: Walk one room with a bag. Wrappers, receipts, empty cups. Out.

slides.title: Song 2: things that live elsewhere
slides.body: Grab anything that belongs in another room and put it in a basket.

slides.title: Song 3: one surface
slides.body: Pick the table or counter you see the most. Clear it.

slides.title: Stop when the music stops
slides.body: Seriously. Ending on time makes your brain trust the next reset.
